title: Research a topic with sources
summary: Notes on one subject from public web pages, with a source for every claim.

asks.label: What should it find out about?
Pages to start from, one address per line:

text: Find out about this from public web pages: [subject]. Use several sources that do not copy each other, write down only what they say, and put a source after every claim. Say plainly what you could not find. Start from these pages if I give any: [pages]
